Before stale capability rejection becomes terminal, schedule one bounded targeted live probe for only the candidate provider outside runtime-admission and canonical locks; do not rebuild or probe the whole fleet.

Only a fresh authoritative live success may transition the provider to healthy and permit dispatch; failed, revoked, quota, timeout, unsupported, or ambiguous probes remain fail closed with an explicit reason.

Coalesce concurrent recovery attempts, rate-limit repeated failed probes, and preserve normal pre-dispatch fresh probing so recovery cannot create a thundering herd or bypass launch checks.

acceptance: Take a fresh authoritative snapshot; enumerate every task-agent pair currently at failure-loop/chair threshold with status, owner/reviewer, failure kind/count/timestamps, PID starttime, queue event, worktree/branch, PR/check/merge truth, and dependencies.

Do not weaken or reset the threshold globally. Every mutation is task-scoped, uses governed status commands, and has before/after event and canonical readback evidence.

After reconciliation, recompute Codex and Codex2 direct/helper eligibility and active/pending loads. Prove available slots dispatch independent eligible work; if fewer than four run, identify the exact dependency, review, failure-loop, or lack-of-work reason.
